Subject: Hosted API: token & peak TPS confirmation for SummitEdge

Hi Carlos — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can size Dedicated vs Hosted recommendations and a pricing band: 

Summary of what I captured from the demo/ops notes:
- Primary product flow: conversational assistant + retrieval augmentation for knowledge base + periodic batch ingestion for new docs.
- Expected monthly tokens (user prompts + model responses): 55M — 120M tokens (range given during call).
- Typical steady-state average: ~2.8M tokens/day (~85M/month if sustained).
- Peak TPS: 18-22 TPS for short bursts tied to morning batch jobs + peak usage windows (US East).
- Latency SLO: 150–250ms p95 target for chat flows.

Open asks for accuracy so pricing can be aligned:
1) Can you confirm the left/right endpoints above (monthly lower/upper bound and peak TPS) or provide a tighter single-point estimate for budgeting?
2) Any planned growth events in the next 3 months (marketing push / feature launch) that could double peak TPS temporarily?
3) Are you targeting a dollar-per-1M-tokens budget today (ballpark)? If not, is finance the right contact (cc'd) to discuss target $/1M?

Attached: summitedge_usage_estimates.xlsx — I converted the numbers you shared into day/week/month buckets. Also attached Redwood pricing snapshot for hosted bands.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the numbers above (1–3) by EOD Wed.
- If upper bound (120M / 22 TPS) looks likely, we'll put together a Dedicated sizing + hosted fallback plan and a tailored price band.
- If narrower, we'll draft a hosted-only proposal with a target $/1M to align with your budget.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick 15-min follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

— Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the clear recap and for pulling the sheet together. Confirming a few details from our side after syncing with Maya (ops) and Finance (cc):

- Monthly tokens: we expect to land in the 70M–95M range for Q4. The 55M lower bound was an early conservative estimate; with the pilot user group expanding we'll most likely be in the 80M neighborhood.
- Peak TPS: ops confirmed current peaks near ~16–18 TPS, and a planned marketing burst on Nov 15 could push short bursts to ~30 TPS for 20–30 minutes. That burst is one-off for the launch.
- Budget target: Finance is aiming for $450–$650 per 1M tokens, with flexibility if reliability SLAs and latency targets are met.

Two quick notes:
1) We prefer a hosted model initially but want to understand the economics of switching to Dedicated if steady-state approaches the upper bound.
2) Maya will send through a sanitized sample traffic profile (hourly) by tomorrow to help footprinting.

Can you draft two options: (A) hosted-only pricing for 80M tokens/month with the one-off burst protection plan, and (B) hybrid with Dedicated reserved capacity for steady-state and hosted burst overflow?

Carlos
VP Product, SummitEdge
carlos@summitedge.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Diaz <carlos@summitedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, SummitEdge Finance <finance@summitedge.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 00:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Hosted API: token & peak TPS confirmation for SummitEdge

Carlos — perfect, this is really helpful. I sketched two concrete options and attached an updated pricing snapshot. High level:

Option A — Hosted-only (targeted for 80M/month)
- Reference unit price: $575 / 1M tokens (mid of Finance range) with step discounts at 100M+
- Included: automatic burst smoothing (short spikes up to 30 TPS) for up to 30 minutes/day, prefix cache for retrieval augmentation
- Estimated monthly cost (80M): ~$46k before discounts and any reserved credits

Option B — Hybrid (Reserved Dedicated + Hosted overflow)
- Reserved Dedicated for 60M tokens-equivalent steady-state (~12–15 TPS sustained), monthly commit with discounted unit rate $420 / 1M equivalent on Dedicated consumption
- Hosted overflow handles bursts (above reserved capacity) at $650 / 1M for overflow usage
- Estimated blended cost (80M with one 30-minute 30TPS burst): ~$39k/month plus a small reserved capacity commitment (negotiable)

Notes and tradeoffs:
- Hybrid reduces unit economics for steady traffic and protects against large monthly bill swings, but requires a 3–6 month commit to receive the lower Dedicated rate.
- Hosted-only gives fastest time-to-value and no commitment but has higher peak-unit costs and potential rate variability for sustained high throughput.

Next steps:
1) Priyom — can you slot an ops sizing note (basic GPU pool & burst headroom) so we have an estimate to share with SummitEdge?
2) Carlos / Finance — tell us which option you prefer for a formal quote. If you want, we can prepare a 30-day pilot hosted contract at the hosted-only rate with a usage cap to limit spend during the launch.

If helpful I can also run a quick cost-sensitivity table that shows blended $/1M as you vary monthly tokens between 60–120M and with 0–3 burst events.

Thanks — Ben
